newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Taleban warplane bombs former Afghan govt position.
newsitem.headline: Taleban warplane bombs former Afghan govt position.

text.p: A Taleban plane bombed positions held by former Afghan government troops north of Kabul on Tuesday while five civilians were killed when a Taleban rocket hit their home in the village of Kalakan.

A large cloud of dust climbed into the air below the De Sabz pass 30 km (20 miles) north of the Afghan capital, where bombs struck positions occupied by troops and armour under former government military chief Ahmad Shah Masood.
